title: Wedding toast (Bridge)
script:
Tunde and Amaka met at karaoke, both reaching for the same Whitney Houston song.
They've been doing duets ever since, mostly arguing over who gets the Beyoncé part.
Their first holiday was a road trip with nothing but Fela Kuti and a broken GPS.
May your marriage outlast every season of Grey's Anatomy.
note: Original material; the couple is fictional. Bridge: friends 18-34 and parents 55+. Beats: the AI-only baseline says Whitney and Beyoncé land for everyone; Qloo says otherwise. Each reference is judged on the weaker crowd. Fela Kuti is the culturally right pick for this couple: amber, and the writer keeps it.
